title: Wails.Net Capability
description: Wails.Net capability declaration. Defines a named bundle of permissions that can be granted to specific windows or remote origins. Mirrors the shape consumed by PermissionManager / CapabilityFileLoader at startup.

identifier.description: Unique capability identifier (e.g. main-capability). Matches Tauri v2 capability identifier.

description.description: Human-readable description shown in tooling and audit logs.

permissions.description: Permission identifiers included in this capability. A leading '!' denotes an explicit deny entry that overrides grants.

windows.description: Window names this capability applies to. Empty array means all windows (global grant).

remote.description: Remote URL patterns allowed for this capability. Local origins (wails://, http(s)://localhost, http(s)://127.0.0.1) are always allowed regardless of this list.

platforms.description: Platform identifiers this capability applies to. Empty array means all platforms.

plugin.description: Optional plugin name this capability belongs to. Filled in by plugin declarations at runtime; not consumed by CapabilityFileLoader.
